sections.title: Start here
steps: Use Hardcopy Documents for physical records and Softcopy Documents for controlled electronic records.
Use External Documents for records received from outside the organization.
Use My Requests to ask for an approved change. Use My Tasks to complete assigned approval steps and physical transfer handoffs.
Authorized staff can register documents or apply changes directly from the document registers.
Read the result after each action. Select Got it to close a notice; check the record or request status before continuing.
sections.result: Choose the correct register and procedure before entering or changing a record.
notes: Menus, records, and actions depend on your active roles, permissions, and document access.
A saved request draft does not create, revise, move, assign, or dispose of a document.

sections.title: Who does what
steps: Administrator manages accounts, permissions, workflows, reference records, audit, and backups.
Document Control Officer manages direct document actions, assignments, storage references, categories, and document control records.
Plant Manager reviews assigned approval tasks and can use the document and request access granted to the account.
Internal Auditor reviews permitted documents, histories, and audit records.
Staff works with assigned or granted documents and submits permitted requests.
sections.result: Each person uses their own account and acts within the access granted to it.
notes: These are the standard role duties. Administrators can change permissions and create additional roles.
Primary role and Assigned roles work together. An approval task must be assigned to your account or one of your roles.

sections.title: Sign in and set your password
steps: Enter Username and Password, then select Sign In.
If Change your temporary password appears, enter Current or temporary password, New password, and Confirm new password.
Use a different password with at least 9 characters, then select Set permanent password.
Later, open your account name, choose Change Password, complete the same fields, then select Update Password and Confirm.
To leave, open your account name, select Sign Out, and confirm.
sections.result: Your permanent password gives access to the menus allowed for your account.
notes: For a forgotten password or disabled account, contact the Administrator.
After repeated failed sign-ins, wait before trying again or ask the Administrator for help.
If the system reports that your password is too long, shorten it and try again.

sections.title: Choose the right workspace
steps: Open Overview for the totals and recent activity available to your account.
Under Document Management, choose Hardcopy Documents, Softcopy Documents, or External Documents.
Open My Requests and choose the tab for the action you need. Open My Tasks for work assigned to you.
Authorized controllers use Document Assignments and Setup Places.
Administrators also use User Management, Roles & Permissions, Workflow Builder, and Backup & Restore.
sections.result: You reach the page that matches the work you are authorized to perform.
notes: A missing menu or action usually means your account does not have the required permission.
Use the menu button on a narrow screen to show or hide the sidebar.

sections.title: Find and inspect documents
steps: Open the appropriate document register and choose Table or Folder.
Search for the title or reference. Apply the available status, category, owner, date, or retention filters.
In Folder view, expand the storage or category tree. Use folder links or the path above the list to change folders.
Select a title or View to inspect the full record. Use Previous, Next, or the page controls to browse more records.
sections.result: You see the documents and details available within your access.
notes: Hardcopy folders follow Area, Specific, optional Asset, then Location. Softcopy and External folders follow their own categories.
Clear filters and return to All Documents when a record appears to be missing.

sections.title: Register a hardcopy directly
sections.audience: Administrator or authorized current holder / controller
steps: Open Hardcopy Documents and select Add New Hardcopy Document.
Enter Document Title. Choose Area, Specific, optional Asset, and Location.
Check Current Holder. Administrators can choose an active user; other users register the record under their own account.
If needed, enable Track retention period and enter Retention Start and Retention End. Add Reason / Notes if useful.
Select Save Document, review the confirmation, and select Confirm.
sections.result: An Active hardcopy record is registered immediately with its storage location and holder.
notes: Location must match the selected storage hierarchy. Asset is optional.
Hardcopy registration uses this direct form. New hardcopy create requests are unavailable.

sections.title: Update a hardcopy record
steps: Open Hardcopy Documents, find the Active record, and inspect View Details.
Select Edit and update Document Title, storage choices, or retention settings as needed.
Check Current Holder and any retention dates before saving.
Select Save Document and Confirm. Reopen View Details to check the result.
sections.result: The document details you are allowed to change are saved immediately.
notes: Use a Hardcopy Transfer Request when an approved physical handoff is required.
New hardcopy update requests are unavailable. If the record changed while you were editing, refresh and recheck it.
Reason / Notes is saved when you register the document; changes to this field during Edit are not saved.

sections.title: Check the holder and storage location
steps: Find the hardcopy in Hardcopy Documents and open View Details.
Check the current Holder and the complete Area, Specific, Asset, and Location information.
Review the available Related Requests, approval history, and transfer history.
Before collecting or releasing the original, confirm the current holder and any unfinished transfer.
sections.result: You know where the physical record should be and who currently holds it.
notes: A transfer approval does not by itself change the stored holder or location; the recipient must Accept the handoff.
An assignment changes the holder without recording a physical transfer handoff.

sections.title: Create a softcopy directly
steps: Open Softcopy Documents and select Add New Softcopy Document. Set Softcopy Action to Create Softcopy.
Enter Subject / Reason and Proposed Document Title. Choose Category and check Generated Document Number.
If you need an existing number with a new series, follow the document numbering procedure.
Attach Document File. Enter Effective Date if needed and optional Remarks.
Select Approve Directly and Confirm. Check the success notice and the new record.
sections.result: The Active softcopy and its first approved file are available immediately at revision 00.
notes: The final document number is assigned when the action is applied; the displayed number is a preview.
Document File is required. Leave Effective Date blank to use the approval date.

sections.title: Revise a softcopy directly
steps: Open Softcopy Documents, find the Active document, and select Edit.
Check Existing Softcopy Document and the automatic next revision level.
Enter Subject / Reason, Proposed Document Title, and Number of Pages. Add an optional Effective Date and Remarks.
Attach the replacement Document File, then select Approve Directly and Confirm.
Reopen the document and check its current revision and file.
sections.result: The replacement file becomes current immediately and the revision level increases automatically.
notes: The document number, series, and category stay with the existing document.
Earlier revisions remain in the permitted history, but their files cannot be downloaded as the current controlled copy.

sections.title: Request a new softcopy
steps: Open My Requests, choose Softcopy Request, and select New Request.
Choose Create Softcopy. Enter Subject / Reason and Proposed Document Title, then select Category.
Check Generated Document Number, or use Need Series Number? for an existing number with a new series.
Attach Document File, add optional Remarks, then select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check the saved request with View Details or Review File. Select Submit, Continue, and Confirm.
sections.result: The request follows its published approval process; final approval creates the Active softcopy at revision 00.
notes: A file is required before submission. The request form does not ask for an Effective Date.
The final document number is assigned on final approval and may differ from the preview.

sections.title: Request a softcopy revision
sections.audience: Authorized requesters with access to the document
steps: Open My Requests, choose Softcopy Request, and select New Request.
Choose Revise Softcopy and select Existing Softcopy Document.
Check Proposed Document Title and the automatic next revision level. Enter Subject / Reason and Number of Pages.
Attach the proposed replacement Document File, add optional Remarks, then select Save Draft and Confirm.
Use Review File to check the attachment. Select Submit, Continue, and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval makes the replacement file current and records the next revision level.
notes: When editing your draft, you can keep the attached file or upload a replacement.
Softcopy cancellation requests are unavailable; ask an authorized controller when the record needs disposal.

sections.title: Use document and series numbers
steps: For a new document number, choose Category and leave Need Series Number? unchecked.
Review Generated Document Number. Its prefix and sequence come from the category's Code Pattern.
To reuse a number, check Need Series Number?, choose an existing Document Number in that category, and enter Series Number.
Check the displayed previously used series numbers and use a new combination.
Finish the direct creation or request procedure.
sections.result: The record receives either the next category number or the selected existing number with its unique series.
notes: Series Number identifies a separate record under an existing number; revisions keep the same number and series.
If the preview is blank or no number is available, contact the controller to check the category.

sections.title: Register an external document directly
steps: Open External Documents and select Add New External Document.
Enter Document Title, choose Category, and add Description if useful.
Use Attach File to select the external document.
Select Save Directly and Confirm.
Find the new record and check its title, category, description, and revision level.
sections.result: The Active external document and its approved attachment are available immediately at revision 00.
notes: A replacement file is required for every later revision.
External documents use their own categories and do not have retention fields.

sections.title: Revise an external document directly
steps: Open External Documents, find the Active document, and select Edit.
Check or update Document Title, Description, and Category.
Use Attach File to select the replacement document.
Select Save Directly and Confirm.
Check the new revision level and use Download to inspect the current file if permitted.
sections.result: The document details and attachment update immediately; the revision level increases automatically.
notes: You can revise only an Active external document that you have permission to manage.
The previous attachment is replaced; Download gives you the current approved file.
Earlier external revision records and files remain stored; the register does not provide a separate File History action.

sections.title: Request an external document registration
steps: Open My Requests, choose External Document Request, and select New Request.
Set External Document Action to External Create Request and enter Subject / Reason.
Enter Document Title, select External Category, and add Description if useful.
Use Attach File, add optional Remarks, then select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check View Details and Review File, then select Submit, Continue, and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval registers the Active external document and its approved attachment at revision 00.
notes: External categories are separate from Softcopy Categories.
An attachment is required before submission. External retention dates are not part of this process.

sections.title: Request an external document revision
sections.audience: Authorized requesters with access to the document
steps: Open My Requests, choose External Document Request, and select New Request.
Choose External Revised Request and select Existing External Document.
Enter Subject / Reason. Check or update Document Title, External Category, and Description.
Attach the replacement file, add optional Remarks, then select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check Review File, then select Submit, Continue, and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval updates the external document and makes the next automatic revision current.
notes: The existing external document must be Active and accessible to your account.
When editing your draft, keep the attachment or upload a replacement.

sections.title: Download, print, and inspect file history
sections.audience: Users with the required file permissions
steps: Open Softcopy Documents and find the Active document.
Select Download to save the current approved file, or Print to open its print viewer.
For a PDF, image, or text file, wait for the preview and select Print. Download Office files and print them in Word, Excel, or WPS.
Use File History or the Document Files details section to inspect permitted revision information.
In External Documents, use Download on an Active record to save its current attachment.
sections.result: You receive the current approved file within your download or print permissions.
notes: Files may be PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG/JPEG, DOCX, or XLSX; uploads must not exceed 15 MB.
Superseded, disposed, and cancelled document files are unavailable for normal download.
File History and Document Files revision history are Softcopy features. External Documents show the current revision and Download.

sections.title: Review a request attachment
sections.audience: Requester or the currently assigned approver
steps: Find the softcopy or external request in My Requests or My Tasks and select Review File.
Review PDF, image, or text files in the browser when supported.
For DOCX or XLSX, choose Open in Word or Open in Excel, Open in WPS, or Download.
Allow the browser to open the installed application. If it cannot, download the file and open the saved copy.
Return to the request to edit the proposal or record your approval decision.
sections.result: You review the proposed file before submission or approval.
notes: Office app links expire after 10 minutes. Refresh Review File to renew them.
Changes to a review copy do not update the system document; the requester must attach the revised file.
For first-time WPS use, Download WPS opener setup and follow its included instructions.

sections.title: Save, submit, and follow requests
steps: Complete the appropriate New Request form and select Save Draft, then Confirm.
Use View Details to check the proposal. Edit is available for your Draft or Returned request.
Select Submit, Continue, and Confirm to send the request to its published approval process.
Follow Status, Approval Process Timeline, and Workflow Activity Log. Edit and resubmit a Returned request after addressing the feedback.
Cancel an unwanted Draft. If Delete appears on its Cancelled record, confirm only to permanently remove that never-submitted draft.
sections.result: The request records its progress from Draft to Submitted and the final outcome.
notes: Submitted requests cannot be edited or cancelled by the requester. Rejected requests are closed.
Most final approvals produce Completed. Transfer approval still needs Dispatch and Accept.
A resubmitted Returned request follows its original approval process.

sections.title: Approve, return, or reject a request
sections.audience: Assigned approvers, including requester confirmation steps
steps: Open My Tasks and choose the relevant request tab.
Use View Details to inspect the proposal, Approval Process Timeline, and Workflow Activity Log.
For softcopy and external creation or revision, use Review File before deciding.
Choose Approve, Return, or Reject. Add an optional Remark explaining the decision, then select Continue and Confirm.
Check the recorded result and the next task or request status.
sections.result: Approve advances the request or applies the final change; Return sends it back for review; Reject closes it.
notes: Return at the first step sends the request to its requester for correction.
Return at a later step sends it to the immediately previous approver; the request remains Submitted.
Tasks are assigned by the published process, which can include a Requester account confirmation step.

sections.title: Know who reviews each request
steps: Softcopy and External Create or Revise: Requester's leader, then Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer.
Hardcopy Transfer and Document Access: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester confirmation.
Document Assignment: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester's leader.
Disposal: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester confirmation.
Use Approval Process Timeline to find the next reviewer. Workflow administrators can check the published route in Workflow Builder.
sections.result: You can identify the next review or confirmation needed before the request can finish.
notes: These are the local published routes checked on 5 November 2026. An authorized administrator can change future routes.
Submitted and Returned requests keep their original route. Their approvers may differ from a later published default.
Requester confirmation is an approval step in My Tasks. Physical Dispatch and Accept remain separate transfer steps.

sections.title: Request a physical hardcopy transfer
steps: Open My Requests, choose Hardcopy Transfer Request, and select New Request.
Choose Hardcopy Document and check Original Places and Holder.
Choose Destination Area, Specific, optional Asset, and Location, then select Receiving User.
Enter Request Subject and optional Remarks. Select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check the proposal, then select Submit, Continue, and Confirm.
sections.result: After final approval, the document is For Transfer and awaits the requester's Dispatch.
notes: Choose a different active destination with matching storage choices.
The original holder and location remain until the intended recipient accepts the physical document.
Another submitted access, assignment, or transfer request for you and this document can block submission.

sections.title: Dispatch the approved hardcopy
steps: After final approval, open My Tasks and choose Hardcopy Transfer Request.
Find the document under Physical Transfer Handoffs and check that its stage is For Transfer.
Check the intended recipient and arrange the physical release.
Select Dispatch, then select Continue and Confirm.
Check that the stage changes to In Transit.
sections.result: The system records dispatch and waits for the intended recipient to confirm receipt.
notes: Only the transfer requester can Dispatch; being the current holder alone does not give this action.
Dispatch does not yet change the recorded holder or location.

sections.title: Accept a transferred hardcopy
steps: Receive the physical document and confirm that it matches the approved transfer.
Open My Tasks, choose Hardcopy Transfer Request, and find the In Transit item under Physical Transfer Handoffs.
Check the document and approved destination.
Select Accept, then select Continue and Confirm.
Reopen Hardcopy Documents to check the new holder and location.
sections.result: The transfer becomes Accepted, the request becomes Completed, and custody and storage move to the recipient and approved destination.
notes: Only the selected recipient can Accept. Report any changed holder, inactive location, or destination mismatch to the controller.
The previous holder's personal access grants are revoked when custody changes through this handoff.

sections.title: Request or renew document access
steps: Open My Requests, choose Document Access Request, and select New Request.
Choose Document Type: Softcopy or Hardcopy. Select the document and enter Subject.
Check Recipient / Assigned User; it is your own account. Choose Access Expires At after today.
Add optional Remarks, then select Save Draft and Confirm. Submit the saved request with Continue and Confirm.
After completion, reopen the register. To extend access, submit a new access request with a later expiry date.
sections.result: Final approval grants your account access through the selected expiry date.
notes: Access is for the requester and does not change the holder or move the document.
Download and print still require their own permissions. External documents are not offered in this request.
An unfinished related request for the same requester and document can block submission.

sections.title: Request a document assignment
steps: Open My Requests, choose Document Assignment Request, and select New Request.
Choose Document Type: Softcopy or Hardcopy, then select the document.
Enter Subject and check Recipient / Assigned User; it is your own account.
Add optional Remarks. Select Save Draft and Confirm, then Submit, Continue, and Confirm.
After completion, check the document's holder or assignment.
sections.result: Final approval assigns the document to you. A hardcopy assignment changes its holder without moving its location.
notes: Softcopy assignment adds or reactivates your assignment and preserves other assignees.
Use a transfer request when physical movement and recipient receipt must be recorded.
External documents are not offered in this request.

sections.title: Request hardcopy or external disposal
steps: Open My Requests, choose Disposal Request, and select New Request.
Enter Subject / Reason and choose Document Type: Hardcopy or External Document.
Select the Active document and recheck its details in the register.
Choose Disposal Reason: Shred, Scratch, or Other. If Other, enter Other Reason. Add optional Remarks.
Select Save Draft and Confirm, then Submit, Continue, and Confirm. After completion, check the record using the Disposed filter.
sections.result: The document becomes Disposed only after the approval process finishes, and disposal details are recorded.
notes: Other Reason is required for Other and must be no more than 250 characters.
Softcopy is not offered for disposal requests; an authorized controller uses direct Dispose.
Retention alerts do not submit or approve disposal automatically.

sections.title: Dispose of a document directly
steps: Open Hardcopy Documents, Softcopy Documents, or External Documents and inspect the Active record.
Select Dispose on the intended document.
Choose Disposal Reason: Shred, Scratch, or Other. For Other, enter Other Reason.
Select Continue and Confirm after checking the document and reason.
Use the Disposed status filter to find the record and check the recorded result.
sections.result: The record becomes Disposed immediately and its disposal history is recorded.
notes: You need direct permission for the register, disposal permission, and access to manage that record.
Disposed softcopy and external files cannot be downloaded through their normal file actions.
Follow the organization's physical disposal procedure as well as recording the action.

sections.title: Assign documents directly
steps: Open Document Assignments and choose Hardcopy / Places or Softcopy / Categories.
Select Assign Document, choose the document and Assigned User, then select Save Assignment and Confirm.
For bulk hardcopy assignment, choose Location and Assigned User, then select Assign All and Confirm.
For bulk softcopy assignment, choose Category / Subcategory and Assigned User, then select Assign All and Confirm.
Check the resulting assignments and the success or error notice.
sections.result: Hardcopy assignment changes the holder; softcopy assignment adds the user while retaining other active assignees.
notes: Bulk softcopy assignment includes subcategories. Bulk hardcopy assignment covers Active documents at the selected Location.
Finish open For Transfer or In Transit handoffs before assigning affected hardcopies.
Assignment does not record physical Dispatch or Accept.

sections.title: Monitor hardcopy retention
steps: When registering or editing a hardcopy, enable Track retention period if monitoring is required.
Enter Retention Start and Retention End. The end date must be on or after the start date.
In Hardcopy Documents, use Due Today, Overdue, Due in the Next 7 Days, or Due in 8-30 Days to find records needing attention.
Open View Details to check Days until disposal. If permitted, use Edit to inspect the saved Retention Start and Retention End.
When Retention period reached appears, review the listed records, then select Got it and follow the approved disposal process if required.
sections.result: Retention dates help you identify records requiring review.
notes: Retention notifications cover visible Active hardcopies with an end date of today or earlier.
Closing the alert does not change the record or dispose of it.
External documents have no retention fields.

sections.title: Set up physical storage locations
steps: Open Setup Places and use the Area, Specific, Asset, and Location tabs.
Add an Area, then a Specific linked to its Area. Add an Asset Number under its Specific when needed.
Add a Location with Location Name, Sequence, Area, Specific, optional Asset Number, and optional Archive Date.
Select Save Record and Confirm. Use Edit to correct a reference record.
Use Deactivate when a storage entry should no longer appear in new selections. Check the Active or Inactive filter.
sections.result: Document forms show the active storage choices you have set up.
notes: Sequence is unique within each Specific. Leave it blank for an automatic number; keep each storage entry under the correct parent.
Deactivation keeps historical links. Resolve any warning about linked records before trying again.

sections.title: Set up softcopy and external categories
steps: Open Setup Places and choose Softcopy Categories or External Categories.
Select Add Softcopy Categories or Add External Categories. Enter Name, Folder, Description if needed, and optional Parent Id.
For Softcopy Categories, enter Code Pattern with the starting number, such as PPM-001.
Keep Active checked, then select Save Record and Confirm.
Use Edit to maintain details or Deactivate to remove a category from new selections.
sections.result: Softcopies and external documents use their own category folders; softcopy numbering follows its category's Code Pattern.
notes: External Categories do not use a Code Pattern.
Choose the parent carefully. A category cannot be its own parent or sit below one of its own subcategories.

sections.title: Create, reset, or deactivate accounts
steps: Open User Management and select Add User, or Edit an existing account.
Enter the person's name, Username, Position Title, Primary role, Assigned roles, and Leader as needed. Check Active account.
Select Save User and Confirm. Give the generated temporary password to the intended user through your approved channel.
To reset a password, Edit the account, select Generate a new temporary password for this existing account, then Save User and Confirm.
Use Assigned Documents to review the user's documents, when available. Select Deactivate when an eligible account must stop signing in.
sections.result: The account receives its selected access. The user must replace a generated temporary password before continuing into the system.
notes: Temporary passwords are shown once. Use a reset if the user no longer has that password.
You cannot deactivate yourself or remove the last active Administrator.
Account protections can block changes to your own roles or protected Administrator accounts.

sections.title: Maintain roles and permissions
steps: Open Roles & Permissions and select Add Role, or Edit an existing editable role.
Enter Role Name and select the required Module Permissions.
Check document visibility, direct actions, request actions, file actions, and administration access separately.
Select Save Role and Confirm, then review the account's Primary role and Assigned roles in User Management.
Use Deactivate or Remove only when offered for an unused role.
sections.result: Active assigned roles combine to determine the account's permitted menus and actions.
notes: The Administrator role is protected.
A role used by users, approval processes, or unfinished requests cannot be removed until those links are resolved.
A role name alone does not assign an approval task; the published process must route the task to it.

sections.title: Build and publish an approval process
steps: Open Workflow Builder, find the request process to maintain, and select Step Actions.
Select Create Next Draft, or Start First Draft when there is no version.
Select Add Approval Step or Edit. Enter Approval Step Name and Approver Type, select the role or person when required, then select Save Step.
Arrange steps with Move Up and Move Down; use Remove for an unwanted step.
Check the order and active approvers, then select Validate & Publish and confirm.
sections.result: New submissions use the published default approval process.
notes: Approver types are Any active member of role, Specific user, Requester's leader, or Requester account.
Publish 1 to 30 valid steps with active approvers. If a step uses Requester's leader, that leader must be active when submitting.
Submitted and Returned requests keep their original approval process.

sections.title: Respond to task notifications
sections.audience: Assigned approvers and other task recipients
steps: Check the My Tasks count and the notification bell for work requiring your attention.
Open Notifications and choose a listed item to go to its My Tasks page.
Use Previous, Next, and Rows to browse unread notifications.
If Approval needed appears, inspect its listed tasks and open the relevant request.
Complete the task from My Tasks using its approval or handoff procedure.
sections.result: You reach the current task and can record the required action.
notes: Opening a bell item marks that notification read; it does not approve, reject, or finish the task.
Closing a notification with Got it does not complete the work.
My Requests counts Draft and Returned items; My Tasks counts pending work.

sections.title: Inspect the audit trail
sections.audience: Administrator, Internal Auditor, or authorized reviewer
steps: Open Internal Audit Trail.
Search by user ID, action, subject, recorded time, or outcome; displayed user names are not searched.
Choose All Results, Success, or Failed, apply date filters, then adjust ordering or page controls.
Select View to inspect Recorded At, User, Action, Subject, Result, and recorded Details.
Compare the event with the document's details or the request's Workflow Activity Log when investigating an issue.
sections.result: You can trace the recorded actions available within your audit permission.
notes: Success and failed events help distinguish applied actions from unsuccessful attempts.
Audit access is for review; use the appropriate management page to correct a record.

sections.title: Create, import, and download backups
steps: Open Backup & Restore and check for setup or backup errors.
Select Backup now and Confirm, then wait for the reported result.
Find the archive using search or the Manual, Automatic, or Recovery type filter. Select Download to save an available archive.
To add an existing archive, select Import backup, choose Backup ZIP, then Import backup and Confirm.
Use Clean up and Confirm to remove eligible backup, audit, and log archives older than three months.
sections.result: A successful backup is listed for later download or restore; imported archives are checked before storage.
notes: Backup actions need the appropriate view and edit permissions.
The page displays a daily 5:00 PM Asia/Manila schedule; check Last automatic backup to confirm a recent run.
If setup is incomplete, contact the Administrator before relying on automatic backups.

sections.title: Restore system data from a backup
steps: Open Backup & Restore and identify the archive that should replace the current records and private files.
Select Restore system data and choose Backup to restore.
Enter Your password and type RESTORE in Type RESTORE to confirm.
Select Restore selected backup, read the replacement confirmation, and select Confirm.
After a successful restore signs you out, sign in again and check the restored records and attachments.
sections.result: The selected backup replaces live records and private files after a recovery backup is created.
notes: Restore changes the system for all users; coordinate the operation using your organization's recovery procedure.
Check the archive and date carefully before confirming.
An error notice means the restore needs investigation; read the complete result before retrying.

sections.title: Resolve common problems
steps: If a menu, record, or action is missing, clear filters and check the document status; ask the Administrator to check your roles and access.
If a file upload fails, check the allowed type and 15 MB size limit, then attach the correct file again.
If Submit fails, check required fields and the attachment. Ask the Administrator to check the published process and active approvers.
If a record changed in another session, refresh the page, inspect its latest details, and repeat only the changes still needed.
If an action fails, read Action could not be completed and give the controller the request reference, action, time, and message.
sections.result: You can correct routine input problems and provide enough detail for a controller or Administrator to investigate.
notes: A duplicate number and series needs a different unused combination; a blank generated number needs category review.
For expired review links, reopen Review File. For expired document access, request access again.
Keep your account credentials private and use your own account for every recorded action.
